title: Man City tight-lipped on Rodri transfer amid Barcelona and Real Madrid link
english: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca has declined to clarify the future of midfielder Rodri amid growing transfer rumors involving Barcelona and Real Madrid. Speculation intensified after Rodri was photographed on a flight from Madrid to England, though reports suggest Real Madrid may be priced out of a potential move. Maresca emphasized that while the transfer window remains active, his primary focus is preparing the team for the upcoming Community Shield match against Arsenal.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ሲቲው አሰልጣኝ ኢንዞ ማሬስካ ከባርሴሎና እና ሪያል ማድሪድ ጋር ስሙ የተያያዘው አማካዩ ሮድሪ ስለሚኖረው የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ግልጽ መግለጫ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል። የዝውውር መስኮቱ ክፍት በመሆኑ ማንኛውም ነገር ሊከሰት እንደሚችል የገለጹት አሰልጣኙ፣ ሮድሪ ከማድሪድ ወደ እንግሊዝ ሲጓዝ መታየቱ ውዝግብ ቢፈጥርም ትኩረታቸው አርሰናልን በሚገጥሙበት የኮሚዩኒቲ ሺልድ ጨዋታ ላይ ብቻ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ሮድሪ ከቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ ወደ ልምምድ የተመለሰ ቢሆንም ስለ ዝውውሩ እስካሁን የተረጋገጠ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Leenjisaan Manchestir Siti Inzo Maareskaa, gabaasota gabaa dabarsuu keessatti maqaan Roordirii ka'aa jiru ilaalchisee yaada kennuu irraa of qusataniiru. Roordiriin Maadiriid irraa gara Ingilizitti osoo deemaa jiruu kaameraan qabamuun isaa shakkii guddaa uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, Maareskaan garuu xiyyeeffannaan isaa guutuu tapha kaappii 'Community Shield' kan Arsenal wajjin taphatamu irratti akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Gabaasni tokko tokko akka ibsanitti, gatiin gabaa taphatichaa ሪያል Maadiriid dura dhabuu danda'a jedhamee yaadama.

title: US threatens ‘indefinite’ blockade against Iran: How long can it last?
english: The United States has pledged to maintain an indefinite naval blockade on Iran and plans to implement unprecedented economic sanctions to isolate the country. Despite US claims of control, the Strait of Hormuz remains closed by Iranian authorities, effectively halting maritime traffic in the area. Meanwhile, there are growing internal concerns regarding the well-being of American sailors stationed on the USS Abraham Lincoln due to the prolonged deployment.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአይራን ላይ የጣለችውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ እንደምትቀጥል እና አገሪቱን ለማግለል ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስታውቃለች። የአሜሪካ መንግስት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደቆጣጠረ ቢገልጽም፣ ኢራን በአሁኑ ወቅት የባህር መስመሩን ዘግታ በመያዟ በዚያ አካባቢ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ተቋርጧል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ረጅም ጊዜ በፈጀው ዘመቻ ምክንያት በአሜሪካ የጦር መርከብ ላይ ያሉ መርከበኞች የጤና እና የደህንነት ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Amerikaa qarqara galaana Iranitti kan kuffiste ugguraa galaanaa gara fuulduraatti yeroo hin murtoofneef akka itti fufsiistu fi Iran addunyaa irraa addaan baasuuf tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuuf karoorfatteetti. Mootummaan Amerikaa daandii galaana Hormuz to’annaa isaa jala akka jiru ibsuus, Iran daandii sana cuftee waan jirtuuf sochiin dooniiwwanii adda citee jira. Gama biraatiin, yeroo dheeraa fudhachuu duula kanaatiin walqabatee haalli jireenyaa fi nageenyaa loltoota doonii Amerikaa ‘USS Abraham Lincoln’ irra jiran yaaddoo keessa seenee jira.

title: Russian ballistic attacks intensify as Kyiv claims Dnipropetrovsk advance
english: Ukraine has successfully recaptured 26 settlements in the Dnipropetrovsk region, regaining control over significant territory from Russian forces. Despite this military progress, Russia has ramped up its missile and drone attacks on major Ukrainian cities, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. The ongoing conflict remains intense as Ukraine struggles to defend against these strikes while continuing its counteroffensive operations.
amharic: ዩክሬን በዲኒፕሮፔትሮቭስክ ክልል 26 ሰፈሮችን በተሳካ ሁኔታ መልሳ መቆጣጠር ችላለች። ይህ ወታደራዊ ስኬት ቢኖርም ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ዋና ዋና ከተሞች ላይ የሚሰነዝረውን የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች። ጥቃቱ በዜጎች ላይ ጉዳት እና በታችኛው መዋቅር ላይ ውድመት እያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ ዩክሬን በአንድ በኩል የመልሶ ማጥቃት ዘመቻዋን በሌላ በኩል የራሷን መከላከያ ለማጠናከር እየታገለች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Yukireeniin naannoo Diiniiprooppetiroovsk keessatti ganda 26 irra deebitee to'annaa ishee jala galchiteetti. Milkaa'ina waraanaa kana ta'us, Raashiyaan magaalota gurguddoo Yukireen irratti rukuttaa mizaayilii fi doroniin raawwattu daran cimsiteetti, kunis miidhaa lubbuu fi mancaatii qabeenyaa geessiseera. Yukireeniin gama tokkoon lola ishee itti fufee fi gama biraan immoo miidhaa kana ofirraa ittisuuf qabsaa'aa jirti.

title: Record-breaking rain in Japan leaves several dead, thousands stranded
english: Historic rainfall in Japan's Chiba prefecture has led to severe flooding, resulting in at least four deaths and one missing person. Authorities have issued evacuation orders for over 400,000 residents as flood risks persist. Although the intense rain is subsiding, the region remains under alert for ongoing dangers.
amharic: በጃፓን ቺባ ግዛት የጣለው ከፍተኛ ዝናብ ባስከተለው የጎርፍ አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ አንድ ሰው ደግሞ የደረሰበት አይታወቅም። የጎርፍ አደጋው ስጋት በመቀጠሉ ከ400,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ ትዕዛዝ ተላልፏል። ምንም እንኳን ዝናቡ እየቀነሰ ቢመጣም፣ በክልሉ ያለው አደጋ አሁንም ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Bokkaan roobee hin beekne naannoo Chiibaa Jaappaaniitti roobeen balaa lolaa hammaataa fideen namoonni afur lubbuun isaanii darbeera, namni tokkos badeera. Balaan lolaa waan jiruuf namoota 400,000 ol ta'aniif ajajni gadi ba'uu kennameera. Goolli bokkaa hir'atuus, balaan lolaa naannichatti waan jiruuf of eeggannoon cimaan taasifamaa jira.

title: Palestinians in West Bank village remain under Israeli settler siege for sixth day
english: For six days, Palestinian families in the village of Qusra have been trapped in their homes due to a blockade by Israeli settlers. Despite an announced military operation, the settlers remain, and reports suggest that Israeli forces have instead restricted access to the area and taken over some private homes. The families are suffering from a lack of essential supplies like food, water, and electricity as the situation continues to escalate.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው ኩስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች ከበባ ውስጥ ለስድስት ቀናት ቆይተዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር ሰፋሪዎችን ለማስወጣት ዘመቻ መጀመሩን ቢገልጽም፣ ሰፋሪዎቹ ቦታውን አልለቀቁም፤ እንዲያውም ወታደሮች አንዳንድ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን በመቆጣጠር ለነዋሪዎች የሚደርሰውን የእርዳታ አቅርቦት አግደዋል። በዚህም የተነሳ ተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ለምግብ፣ ለውሃ እና ለኤሌክትሪክ እጥረት ተዳርገው ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Maatiiwwan Falastiinii baadiyyaa Qusraa keessa jiraatan guyyaa ja'aaf marsaa qotee bultoota Israa'elii jala jiru. Waraanni Israa'el qotee bultoota kana achii ari'uuf duula jalqabne jedhee ibsee tureyyuu, isaan achi keessaa hin baane; kanaa mannaa waraanni Israa'el manneen jireenyaa tokko tokko to'annoo jala oolchuun gargaarsi akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Rakkoo kana hordofuunis maatiiwwan kun nyaataa fi bishaan dhabuun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Video: Israel inaugurates new illegal settlement in Jenin
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz officially opened a new settlement in Jenin this Thursday. This action took place immediately following the destruction of several Palestinian businesses and properties by Israeli military forces in the same area. The move highlights escalating tensions regarding territorial expansion in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በዚህ ሳምንት ሐሙስ ዕለት በጀኒን አዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ መክፈታቸውን ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዚያው አካባቢ የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ንግድ ቤቶችንና ንብረቶችን ካወደሙ በኋላ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የግዛት ማስፋፋት ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz guyyaa Kamisaa kana magaala Jenin keessatti qubannaa haaraa seeraan alaa ta'e tokko eebbisuun bananiiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraanni Israa'el iddoo sanaatti qabeenyaafi suuqiiwwan warra Falasxiin erga diiganii boodadha. Gochi kun naannichatti babal'ina lafaa wajjin walqabatee rakkoon jiraatu caalaatti hammaachaa adeemu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
english: Brazilian police have recovered eight stolen illustrations by Henri Matisse, valued at approximately $200,000, from a house near São Paulo. The artworks were taken during a robbery at a library last December, leading to the arrest of a 44-year-old man who allegedly kept them for the thieves. While the Matisse collection has been returned, five other stolen engravings by artist Candido Portinari remain missing.
amharic: የብራዚል ፖሊስ ወደ 200,000 ዶላር የሚገመቱ ስምንት የተሰረቁ የሄንሪ ማቲስ ሥዕሎችን ከሳኦ ፓውሎ አቅራቢያ ባለ ቤት አግኝቷል። ባለፈው ታህሳስ ወር ላይ ከቤተ-መጻሕፍት የተሰረቁት እነዚህ የጥበብ ውጤቶች የተገኙት፣ ለሌቦች ሲጠብቅ የነበረ የተጠረጠረ ግለሰብ ሲያዝ ነው። የማቲስ ሥዕሎች ወደ ቤተ-መጻሕፍቱ የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ከዚሁ ዘረፋ ጋር የተወሰዱት የካንዲዶ ፖርቲናሪ አምስት የተቀረጹ ሥዕሎች እስካሁን አልተገኙም።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Brazil, fakkiiwwan Henri Matisse saddeet kan gatiin isaanii gara $200,000 ga'u, mana tokko keessatti argachuun deebiseera. Fakkiiwwan kun ji'a Muddee darbe mana kitaabaa tokko keessaa kan hataman yoo ta'u, nama isaan hidhe keessa ture tokko to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Fakkiiwwan Matisse gara mana kitaabaatti deebi'aniiru, garuu fakkiiwwan kaxxaallaa Candido Portinari shan kanneen hataman sana keessatti argaman amma iyyuu hin argamne.

title: Scrutiny over Farage’s finances has ‘hurt Reform UK support’
english: Although Nigel Farage successfully secured a seat in parliament, political experts believe his party's reputation has suffered. Increased attention regarding his personal financial dealings has negatively impacted public support for Reform UK. Analysts suggest this ongoing controversy is currently hindering the party's growth.
amharic: ናይጄል ፋራጅ በፓርላማ መቀመጫቸውን ማሸነፍ ቢችሉም፣ ስለ ፋይናንስ ሁኔታቸው የሚነሱ ጥያቄዎች በፓርቲያቸው ተወዳጅነት ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ አሳድረዋል። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ በግል የገንዘብ ጉዳዮቻቸው ላይ ያለው ትኩረት የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲን ድጋፍ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። ይህ ውዝግብ በአሁኑ ወቅት የፓርቲውን ተቀባይነት እየገደበው ይገኛል።
oromo: Nigel Farage mana maree keessatti bakka bu'ummaa isaa mirkaneeffatus, haalli qabeenya isaa irratti ka'aa jiru hordoffiin isaa paartii isaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa ogeeyyonni siyaasaa ibsaniiru. Dhimmi maallaqaa isaa xiyyeeffannoo argachuun isaa, deeggarsi paartii 'Reform UK' akka hir'atu taasiseera. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, falmiin kun ammaaf guddina paartichaa miidhaa jira.

title: Seven killed in tunnel accident at Indian hydropower project
english: A tragic landslide caused water and debris to flood a tunnel at a state-run hydropower construction site in Uttarakhand, India, resulting in at least seven worker deaths. Thirteen people were injured and rescue teams are currently searching for three additional missing individuals. Experts suggest that intense monsoon rains, combined with aggressive infrastructure development in the fragile Himalayan region, are increasingly leading to such dangerous accidents.

title: What next for Nigel Farage after beating Count Binface to become MP once more?
english: Nigel Farage has been re-elected as the Member of Parliament for Clacton following a by-election he triggered himself amidst a controversy over undisclosed political donations. While Farage secured the victory, the contest was unusual due to a boycott by major political parties, leaving a satirical candidate known as Count Binface as his primary opponent. The win is viewed by many as hollow, especially as Farage faces ongoing parliamentary scrutiny regarding his financial disclosures.

title: Gaza starvation: Why Israel's supporters are misrepresenting Unicef study
english: Israel continues to deny accusations that it is using starvation as a weapon of war in Gaza, despite reports from international human rights organizations and the WHO regarding severe hunger crises. Pro-Israel advocates have recently claimed that a new UNICEF study proves famine in Gaza was a hoax, using the findings to dismiss allegations of war crimes. However, these claims are being criticized as misleading distortions of the data, as the study does not negate the existence of a severe humanitarian crisis.

title: New Zealand break ranks with Oceania as FIFA’s Infantino divide grows
english: New Zealand has officially withdrawn its support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino's re-election following a controversial and now abandoned plan to sell stakes in World Cup commercial rights to private investors. While the Oceania Football Confederation continues to back FIFA leadership, New Zealand is demanding an independent investigation into the matter to restore lost trust. This move aligns New Zealand with other major global confederations that are currently challenging Infantino's governance ahead of next year's election.

title: Russia says hit Ukrainian railway and port facilities in new strikes
english: Russia recently conducted airstrikes against a Ukrainian railway station and vessels near Mykolaiv, claiming they were used for military logistics. In retaliation, Ukraine launched drone attacks against Russian oil infrastructure, including a major Baltic port and a warehouse near Moscow. These ongoing exchanges have prompted regional security alerts and air travel disruptions across both Russia and neighboring Baltic countries.

title: Swiatek defeats Rybakina to claim Canadian Open title​
english: Iga Swiatek secured her first title of the season by defeating Elena Rybakina in the Canadian Open final with a decisive 6-2, 6-3 victory. Although Swiatek dominated the match in Toronto, she revealed feeling emotionally conflicted due to recent public pressure regarding her performance this year. Rybakina struggled to keep up physically, likely due to exhaustion from a demanding schedule leading up to the final.

title: UK far-right leader Farage re-elected in boycotted by-election
english: Nigel Farage has secured re-election as a UK Member of Parliament following a period of resignation linked to financial concerns. The election process was marked by a boycott and a lack of traditional competition, leaving a comedian known as Count Binface as his primary opponent. Farage did not attend the final announcement of the results.

title: La Liga: Barcelona key talking points heading into new 2026-27 season
english: Barcelona is entering the 2026-27 season aiming for a third consecutive La Liga title, a feat they have not achieved since the Pep Guardiola era. Following their recent dominance over Real Madrid and significant contributions to Spain's recent World Cup victory, the team is widely considered the favorite to win again. Despite the departure of captain Ronald Araujo, the squad remains young and highly talented, though manager Hansi Flick must manage player fatigue after the international tournament.
amharic: ባርሴሎና የፔፕ ጋርዲዮላ ዘመን በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሶስት ተከታታይ የላሊጋ ዋንጫዎችን ለማንሳት በዝግጅት ላይ ነው። በቅርቡ ከሪያል ማድሪድ የላቀ ብቃት ማሳየታቸው እና ለስፔን የዓለም ዋንጫ ድል ያበረከቱት አስተዋፅኦ ቡድኑን የውድድሩ ዋነኛ ተወዳጅ አድርጎታል። ምንም እንኳን አምበሉ ሮናልድ አራውጆ ቢለቅም፣ ወጣቱ የባርሴሎና ስብስብ ለድል ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Barcelona waggaa 2026-27 kana yeroo sadaffaaf walitti aansee waancaa La Liga injifachuuf qophaa'aa jira; kunis yeroo Pep Guardiola booda isa jalqabaa ta'a. Taphattoonni isaanii injifannoo Waancaa Addunyaa Ispeenirratti gahee guddaa taphachuu fi Real Madrid caaluun isaanii, gareen kun lammataayyuu akka mo'atu abdachiiseera. Kabajamuu kaapiteenii isaanii Ronald Araujo fi dadhabbiin taphattootaa mudachuu danda'us, gareen kun dargaggoota guddina guddaa qaban kan qabateefi qophii gaarii irra kan jiru dha.

title: Israeli bombardments in south Lebanon intensify
english: Israeli military forces have significantly increased their aerial and ground operations across southern Lebanon, targeting wooded areas and villages with airstrikes, artillery, and demolition tactics. Recent reports indicate that areas such as Mansouri and Majdel Zoun have faced consistent bombardment and weapon fire. Furthermore, Israeli armored vehicles have been spotted moving through local towns as the campaign of destruction in the region continues.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኙ የደን አካባቢዎችን እና መንደሮችን በአየር ጥቃት፣ በታጠቁ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና በቦምብ ፍንዳታዎች በማጥቃት ኦፕሬሽናቸውን አጠናክረዋል። በተለይም የማንሱሪ እና ማጅደል ዞውን አካባቢዎች ለከባድ የጦር መሳሪያ እና የአየር ጥቃት ተጋልጠዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪዎች በአካባቢው መንደሮች ውስጥ እየተንቀሳቀሱ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው የጥፋት ዘመቻ ተጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el gammoojjii fi baadiyaalee kibba Libanoos keessatti duula qilleensaarraa, meeshaa gurguddaa fi diiggaa gaggeessuun tarkaanfiisaanii hammaatanii jiru. Gabaasni akka agarsiisutti, bakkeewwan akka Mansuurii fi Majdel Zoun haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi meeshaa waraanaatiin miidhamanii jiru. Kana malees, konkolaattonni waraana Israa'el magaalota naannichaa keessa socho'aa jiraachuun ibsamee, duulli diiggaa guutummaatti itti fufee jira.

title: The paediatric war wounds Dr Abu Sittah tries to heal in Lebanon
english: Dr. Ghassan Abu Sittah is currently treating 11 children in Beirut who have suffered severe, life-changing injuries due to the conflicts in Gaza and Lebanon. The surgeon is performing complex reconstructive procedures, including surgeries for amputations and shrapnel-related complications, to help these young patients recover. His primary goal is to repair their bodies so they can regain function and eventually move forward with prosthetic rehabilitation.
amharic: ዶክተር ጋሳን አቡ ሲታ በሊባኖስ እና በጋዛ በተካሄዱ ጦርነቶች ምክንያት ከባድ የአካል ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን 11 ህጻናት በቤይሩት እየታከሙ ይገኛሉ። የቀዶ ጥገና ሐኪሙ የሕጻናቱን ሕይወት ለማሻሻል የአካል መቆረጥ እና የቦምብ ፍንዳታ ቁርጥራጭ ያስከተለባቸውን ጉዳቶች ለመጠገን ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ዋና ዓላማቸውም ህጻናቱ የሰው ሰራሽ አካል ተጠቅመው ወደ ተሻለ የጤና ሁኔታ እንዲመለሱ ማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Doktar Gasaan Abuu Sitaah daa'imman 11 waraana Gaazaafi Libaanoon irraan miidhaa cimaa geessise irra ga'e biiroo isaa kan Bayruut keessatti yaalaa jira. Ogeessi kun miidhaa gosa gara garaa kan akka qaama hir'achuu fi shrapnel irraa ga'e suphuudhaan daa'imman kun gara jireenya isaanii isa duraatti akka deebi'anuf tattaaffii gochaa jira. Kaayyoon isaa inni guddaan daa'imman kun qaama keessoo fayyadamanii jireenya isaanii itti fufuu akka danda'an gargaaruudha.

title: Tanker hit in Hormuz, UKMTO says
english: A commercial tanker was struck by a drone while passing through the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday. Although the ship suffered slight damage, all crew members remain unharmed. Authorities confirmed that there have been no reports of environmental damage following the incident.
amharic: ሐሙስ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የሚያልፍ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ በድሮን ጥቃት ደርሶበታል። መርከቧ መጠነኛ ጉዳት ቢደርስባትም፣ በውስጧ የነበሩት ሰራተኞች በሙሉ ደህና ናቸው። ከጥቃቱ በኋላ ምንም አይነት የአካባቢ ብክለት አለመከሰቱም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Guyyaa Kamisaa doonii boba'aa fe'atte tokko irratti daandii galaana Hormuz keessa osoo jirtuu rukuttaan doonii miila hin qabne (drone) raawwatameera. Dooniin sun miidhaa xinnoo kan qaqqabeef ta'us, hojjettoonni hundi balaa tokko malee nagaan jiru. Odola kana boodas miidhaan naannoo irra ga'e akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's current political situation in Tigray mirrors the historical failures that led to Eritrea's independence. The government's National Dialogue commission is being criticized for lacking inclusivity, as major political and armed groups remain excluded from the process. By shutting Tigray out of national elections and dialogue, the state risks repeating past mistakes where marginalization fueled conflict rather than unity.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በትግራይ ክልል እየተከተለ ያለው አካሄድ፣ ኤርትራ ከኢትዮጵያ እንድትገነጠል ካደረጉት ታሪካዊ ስህተቶች ጋር ይመሳሰላል። የኢትዮጵያ ሀገራዊ የምክክር ኮሚሽን፣ ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ እና የትጥቅ ቡድኖችን ያላካተተ በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ይገኛል። መንግስት ትግራይን ከምርጫ እና ከውይይት ሂደቶች በማግለሉ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም የነበሩ መጥፎ ታሪኮች እንዳይደገሙ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Haalli siyaasaa Itoophiyaa amma naannoo Tigraayitti mul’achaa jiru, seenaa kanaan dura Itoophiyaan Eritraan akka gargar baatu kan taasiseef haala wal fakkaatuun adeemaa jira. Koreen Marii Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa qaamolee siyaasaa fi waraana guguddaa marii irraa hambisuun isaa mormii cimaa uumeera. Mootummaan Tigraayii filannoo fi marii biyyaalessaa irraa muruun isaa, dogoggorri seenaa darbe deebi'ee akka hin mudanne sodaachisaa jira.

title: Tanzid makes history as Bangladesh dominate first Australia Test
english: Tanzid Hasan made history by becoming the first Bangladeshi player to score a Test century on Australian soil during the opening match in Darwin. Alongside captain Najmul Hossain Shanto, he helped Bangladesh build a commanding 153-run lead by the end of the second day. The tourists finished the day at 351-6, putting them in a strong position to pursue their first-ever Test victory in Australia.
amharic: ታንዚድ ሀሰን በአውስትራሊያ መሬት የቴስት ግጥሚያ ላይ ከመቶ በላይ በማስመዝገብ የመጀመሪያው የባንግላዲሽ ተጫዋች በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርቷል። ከቡድኑ ካፒቴን ናጅሙል ሁሴን ሻንቶ ጋር በመሆን ባንግላዲሽ በሁለተኛው ቀን ማጠቃለያ የ153 የሩጫ ብልጫ እንዲኖራት አድርጓል። ባንግላዲሽ በጨዋታው በስድስት ተጫዋቾች 351 የሩጫ ውጤት በማስመዝገብ በአውስትራሊያ ምድር የመጀመሪያ ድሏን ለማግኘት ጠንካራ አቋም ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Tanzid Hasan taphataa Bangladesh kan jalqabaa biyya Awustiraaliyaa keessatti qabxii dhibba (century) galchuun seenaa hojjateera. Kaapiteenii Najmul Hossain Shanto waliin tahuun, guyyaa lammaffaa irratti Bangladesh qabxii 153 akka dursitu gargaareera. Taphattoonni Bangladesh guyyaa sana qabxii 351-6 irratti xumuruun, Awustiraaliyaa keessatti injifannoo seena qabeessa argachuuf karaa irra jiru.

title: US accuses dozens of countries of helping China avoid Trump’s tariffs
english: The US government has accused over 40 countries, including key trade partners like the EU, Canada, and Mexico, of helping China evade American tariffs. A new White House report claims that these nations are facilitating a massive transshipment scheme where Chinese goods are falsely labeled to enter the US market. The administration warns that this practice costs the US billions in lost revenue and harms domestic workers, promising to use advanced technology to stop such illegal trade activities.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የአውሮፓ ህብረትን፣ ካናዳን እና ሜክሲኮን ጨምሮ ከ40 በላይ ሀገራት ቻይና የጣለችውን የታሪፍ ቀረጥ እንድታመልጥ እያገዙ ነው ሲል ከሰሰ። ነጭ ቤተመንግስት ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ እነዚህ ሀገራት የቻይና ምርቶች በሀሰተኛ መለያ ወደ አሜሪካ እንዲገቡ በማድረግ ከፍተኛ የገቢ ምንጭ እንዲጠፋ አድርገዋል። የአሜሪካ አስተዳደር ይህ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ ሰራተኞች እና ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ጉዳት እያደረሰ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ ህገ-ወጥ የንግድ ልውውጦችን ለማስቆም ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂዎችን እንደሚጠቀም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoota 40 ol, kanneen akka gamtaa Awurooppaa, Kaanaadaa fi Meksikoo dabalatee, Chaayinaan gibira Ameerikaa akka hin kaffalle gargaaraa jiru jechuun himate. Gabaasni mana mootummaa (White House) akka ibsetti, biyyoonni kunneen meeshaaleen Chaayinaa maqaa sobaatin akka Ameerikaa seenan taasisuun mala hinkaaffachuu irratti hirmaachaa jiru. Ameerikaan, gochi kun qarshii biliyoonaan lakkaa'amu akka ishee dhabsiisu fi hojjettoota ishee irratti miidhaa akka geessisu ibsuun, daldala seeraan alaa kana dhaabuuf tekinoolojii ammayyaatti fayyadamuuf akka jirtu beeksise.

title: South Korea players want K League season change due to ‘worsening climate’
english: The South Korean Professional Footballers Association is requesting a shift in the K League schedule to avoid playing during the nation's increasingly dangerous summer heatwaves. They argue that moving to a fall-to-spring calendar would protect player health and align the league with European and Asian standards. While officials acknowledge that cold winter weather remains a challenge, they suggest incorporating a winter break to manage the transition effectively.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ ፕሮፌሽናል እግር ኳስ ተጫዋቾች ማህበር፣ በሀገሪቱ እየጨመረ የመጣውን ከፍተኛ የበጋ ሙቀት ለማስወገድ የኬ ሊግ የውድድር መርሃ ግብር እንዲቀየር እየጠየቀ ነው። ከውድቀት እስከ ጸደይ የሚዘልቅ የውድድር ዘመን መከተል የተጫዋቾችን ጤንነት ከመጠበቁም በላይ፣ ከሌሎች የእስያ እና የአውሮፓ ሊጎች ጋር ተመጣጣኝ ያደርጋቸዋል ብለዋል። የክረምት ብርድ የራሱ ፈተና ቢኖረውም፣ በወቅቱ የዕረፍት ጊዜ በመፍጠር ለውጡን ተግባራዊ ማድረግ እንደሚቻል ማህበሩ ያምናል፡፡
oromo: Waldaan taphattoota kubbaa miilaa ogeeyyii Koriyaa Kibbaa, ho'a guyyaa guyyaan dabalaa jiru irraa taphattoota ittisuuf jecha sagantaan tapha K League akka jijjiiramu gaafachaa jiru. Yeroo qorrisaa fi bonaa gidduutti taphattoonni akka taphatan gochuun fayyaa taphattootaa kan eeguu fi sadarkaa addunyaa wajjin kan walsimsiisu ta'uu ibsameera. Gosti qorraa fi cabbiin yeroo bonaa rakkina ta'us, yeroo kana keessa boqonnaa gahaa kennuun jijjiiramicha milkeessuun akka danda'amu waldaan kun yaada dhiyeesseera.

title: Wildfires force thousands to flee as blazes spread across Europe
english: Severe wildfires are spreading across multiple European nations, including France, Germany, Croatia, and Greece, forcing thousands of residents and tourists to evacuate their homes. The blazes have been fueled by extreme heatwaves and prolonged drought conditions, with experts attributing this trend to the ongoing climate crisis. In Croatia specifically, the situation is critical, as several people have been hospitalized due to fires reaching populated coastal areas.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ፣ በጀርመን፣ በክሮኤሽያ እና በግሪክ የሚከሰቱ ከባድ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎችን እና ቱሪስቶችን ለመፈናቀል ተገደዋል። እነዚህ እሳቶች በአህጉሪቱ በተከሰቱት ከፍተኛ የሙቀት ማዕበል እና የረዥም ጊዜ ድርቅ የተነሳ የተቀጣጠሉ ሲሆን፣ ሳይንቲስቶች ይህንን የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ውጤት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። በተለይም በክሮኤሽያ የቱሪስት ከተሞችን በመውረሩ ምክንያት በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸው ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa cimaa biyyoota Awurooppaa gurguddoo kanneen akka Faransaay, Jarmanii, Kiro'eeshiyaa fi Giriik keessatti ka'een namoonni kumaatamaan lakka'aman mana isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ibidni kun hoo'a qilleensaa cimaa fi hongee dheeraa jiraachaa ture hordofee kan babal'ate yoo ta'u, ogeeyyiin jijjiirama qilleensaa waliin akka wal qabatu ibsu. Keessattuu biyya Kiro'eeshiyaa keessatti ibidni kun magaalaalee turizimii dhaqqabuun isaa namoota hedduu miidhee hospitaala akka galan taasiseera.

title: Engine debris shattered Ryanair window, pulling passenger out, NTSB says
english: A Ryanair flight was forced to return to Greece after an engine fan blade failed due to metal fatigue, sending debris that shattered a passenger window. The impact caused a passenger to be partially pulled out of the aircraft, though others managed to pull him back inside safely. While investigators discovered bird remains in the engine, they have not yet confirmed if a bird strike caused the failure, and the investigation is still ongoing.
amharic: የራያናየር አውሮፕላን ሞተር ውስጥ የነበረ የአየር ማራገቢያ ምላጭ በመሰበሩ ምክንያት አውሮፕላኑ ወደ ግሪክ እንዲመለስ ተገድዷል። የሰበረው የሞተር ክፍል መስታወቱን በመምታቱ አንድ ተሳፋሪ በከፊል ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በሌሎች ተሳፋሪዎች እርዳታ ወደ ውስጥ ተመልሷል። ባለሙያዎች በሞተሩ ውስጥ የአዕዋፍ ቅሪት ቢያገኙም፣ ብልሽቱ በአእዋፍ ግጭት ምክንያት መሆኑን እስካሁን አላረጋገጡም፤ ምርመራውም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Raayaanaayer jedhamu tokko, baalleen maashina isaa tokko cabuun isaa hir'ina sibiilaa irraa kan ka'e ta'uu hordofee, gara Gireekitti deebi'uuf dirqameera. Cabbiiwwan maashinichaa foddaa xiyyaarichaa cabsanii naqannaan, imaltoon tokko gara alaatti harkifamee ture; ta'us, imaltoonni biroo inni gara keessatti akka deebi'u gargaaraniiru. Qorattoonni maashinichaa keessatti haftee allaattiiwwanii argatanus, caccabbiin sun sababa dha'icha allaattii ti jedhanii hin mirkaneessine; qorannoonis itti fufee jira.

title: Stolen Matisse art found in Brazil
english: Brazilian authorities successfully recovered eight stolen artworks by Henri Matisse, which have an estimated value of $200,000. Police have taken one individual into custody in connection with the crime. The recovery marks a significant success in the investigation of these missing pieces.
amharic: የብራዚል ባለስልጣናት በፈረንሳዊው ሰዓሊ ሄንሪ ማቲስ የተሰሩ እና ዋጋቸው 200,000 ዶላር የሚገመት ስምንት ስርቆት የደረሰባቸውን የስነጥበብ ስራዎች ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ከዚህ ስርቆት ጋር በተያያዘ አንድ ግለሰብ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። የጠፉት የስነጥበብ ስራዎች መገኘት ለምርመራው ትልቅ ስኬት ሆኗል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Biraazil hojiiwwan aartii hayyuu fakkii biyya Faransaay Henri Maatis kan gatiin isaanii Doolaara 200,000 ga'u sagal argachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Hojiilee aartii kana hatuudhaan walqabatee namni tokko to'annoo jala ooleera. Qabeenyi kun argamuun isaa qorannoo kanaaf milkaa'ina guddaa dha.

title: South Africa end Nigeria’s Women’s World Cup hope, Ghana beat Ivory Coast
english: South Africa and Ghana have secured the two spots for the FIFA Intercontinental Playoffs after defeating Nigeria and Ivory Coast, respectively. This victory keeps their chances alive for the 2027 Women's World Cup, while Nigeria will miss the tournament for the first time since 1991. Meanwhile, Cameroon, Malawi, Morocco, and Algeria have already earned direct qualification for the World Cup.
amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ጋና ናይጄሪያን እና አይቮሪ ኮስትን በማሸነፍ ለፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ማጣሪያ የጥሎ ማለፍ ጨዋታዎች ሁለት ቦታዎችን ይዘዋል። ይህ ውጤት ለ2027ቱ የሴቶች የዓለም ዋንጫ ያላቸውን ተስፋ ሲያቆይ፣ ናይጄሪያ ከ1991 በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በውድድሩ ሳትሳተፍ ቀርታለች። በሌላ በኩል ካሜሩን፣ ማላዊ፣ ሞሮኮ እና አልጄሪያ ቀጥታ የዓለም ዋንጫ ተሳትፎ ማረጋገጣቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Afrikaan Kibbaa fi Gaanaan biyyoota Naayijeeriyaa fi Ayivori Kosti injifachuun bakka lama kan FIFA Intercontinental Playofff qabatanii jiru. Injifannoon kun abdii isaanii kan bara 2027 World Cup dubartootaaf jiru kan eegu yoo ta'u, Naayijeeriyaan bara 1991 booda yeroo jalqabaaf guddicha kana irraa hafteetti. Gama biraatiin, Kaameruun, Maalaawwii, Moroookoo fi Aljeeriyaan kallattiin qulqullaa'anii jiru.

title: Prichard Colon dies from boxing injury that resulted in 221-day coma
english: Former professional boxer Prichard Colon has passed away at 33, eleven years after suffering a severe brain injury during a 2015 match. Colon had been in a coma for over seven months following an illegal blow to the back of his head during a fight against Terrel Williams. Since regaining consciousness, he required constant medical care until his recent death at his home in Florida.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቦክስ ተወዳዳሪ ፕሪቻርድ ኮሎን እ.ኤ.አ. በ2015 በነበረው የቦክስ ግጥሚያ ወቅት በደረሰበት ከባድ የአንጎል ጉዳት ምክንያት በ33 ዓመቱ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይቷል። አትሌቱ ከተጋጣሚው በተሰነዘረበት ሕገ-ወጥ የጭንቅላት ጀርባ ምት የተነሳ ለረጅም ወራት ኮማ ውስጥ ቆይቶ ነበር። ከኮማው ከወጣ በኋላም ሙሉ ህይወቱን በሌሎች እንክብካቤ ሲኖር ቆይቶ በቅርቡ በፍሎሪዳ በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤቱ አርፏል።
oromo: Leenjisaa fi taphataa sabquunnamtii boogsiin beekamu Prichard Colon, erga bara 2015 tapha irratti miidhaa sammuu cimaa erga irra ga'ee booda waggaa 11f miidhamee turee booda waggaa 33tti du'aan boqote. Koloon tapha Terrel Williams wajjin godhe irratti mataa duuba rukuttaa seeraan alaa irra ga'een ji'oota hedduuf komaa keessa ture. Komaa keessaa erga ba'ee booda, lubbuun jiraachuuf gargaarsa yeroo hunda barbaachisaa ture kan ture yoo ta'u, dhiyeenya kana manasaa kan Florida keessatti du'eera.

title: Nigel Farage defeats Count Binface to reclaim UK parliamentary seat
english: Nigel Farage, leader of the Reform UK party, successfully regained his parliamentary seat in the Clacton by-election after resigning his position last month. He defeated the satirical candidate Count Binface, who secured a personal best result despite the major political parties boycotting the vote. Farage framed his victory as a direct mandate from his constituents against the political establishment.
amharic: የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲ መሪ ናይጄል ፋራጅ ባለፈው ወር ስልጣናቸውን ከለቀቁ በኋላ በተካሄደው የክላክተን የድጋሚ ምርጫ የፓርላማ ወንበራቸውን መልሰው አሸንፈዋል። ፋራጅ ዋና ተቀናቃኛቸው የሆነውን እና ቀልደኛ እጩ ተወዳዳሪ በመባል የሚታወቀውን ካውንት ቢንፌስን በድምፅ ብልጫ ማሸነፍ ችለዋል። ዋና ዋናዎቹ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ምርጫውን በቦይኮት ቢተዉትም፣ ፋራጅ ድላቸውን ለተቋቋመው የፖለቲካ ስርአት የተሰጠ ትልቅ ምላሽ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii Reform UK, Naayjel Faaraaj, ji'a darbe sadarkaa isaanii gadi lakkisanii booda filannoo irra deebii Kilaaktan irratti teessoo paarlaamaa isaanii deeffataniiru. Faaraaj dorgomaa isaanii kan ta'e kaadhimamaa qooslaa jedhamuun beekamu Kaawunt Biinfeesiin sagalee hedduun injifataniiru. Paartonni siyaasaa gurguddoon filannoo kana lagatanis, Faaraaj injifannoo isaanii kana sirna siyaasaa biyyattii irratti mo'annoo argatanitti lakkaawaniiru.

title: Morning update
english: The US has announced plans to implement unprecedented economic sanctions and naval blockades against Iran to prevent it from acquiring nuclear weapons and to stabilize energy prices. Meanwhile, tensions have escalated as Iranian-linked drone activity was reported near Erbil, and the UAE confirmed an attack on two of its oil vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, US officials have officially denied false reports claiming that American sailors died or faced a mental health crisis while deployed on the USS Abraham Lincoln.
amharic: አሜሪካ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል እና የነዳጅ ዋጋን ለማረጋጋት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መልኩ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና የባህር ላይ እገዳ ለመጣል እቅድ አላት። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው የተባሉ ድሮኖች በአርቢል አቅራቢያ ታይተዋል፤ የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስም በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ ውስጥ ሁለት የነዳጅ መርከቦቿ መመታታቸውን አረጋግጣለች። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ አሜሪካ በ USS አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ ላይ ያሉ ወታደሮች መሞታቸውን ወይም የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እንደገጠማቸው የሚነገሩ ወሬዎች ከእውነት የራቁ መሆናቸውን አስተባብላለች።
oromo: Amerikaa, Iraan meeshaa niwukileraa akka hin arganne ittisuufi gatii boba’aa tasgabbeessuuf, tarkaanfii dinagdeeafi duula galaanaarraa dhoorkuu isa kanaan dura hin beekamne fudhachuuf karoorsiteetti. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, Iraan waliin hidhata qabu kan jedhame sochiin xiyyaraa sarara malee (drone) Erbil naannawaatti mul’ateera, akkasumas UAE markabawwan ishee lama kan boba’aa fe’an handaara Ormuz keessatti haleelamu isaanii mirkaneessiteetti. Kana malees, qondaaltonni Amerikaa oduu sobaa markaba waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln irra jiran irratti loltoonni du’an ykn rakkoon fayyaa sammuu mudate jedhamu dhoorkataniiru.

title: Israel carries out large series of explosions, artillery shelling in south Lebanon
english: The Israeli military has launched a series of intense airstrikes and artillery attacks across various towns in southern Lebanon. These operations included significant explosions and the deployment of drones and warplanes over the affected regions. Reports also indicate that Israeli ground forces have begun advancing toward the town of Hadatha.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ድብደባዎችን እና የመድፍ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። በእነዚህ ጥቃቶች ወቅት ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች የተሰሙ ሲሆን የጦር አውሮፕላኖች እና ድሮኖች በአካባቢው ሲመላለሱ ታይተዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ጦር ወደ ሃዳታ ከተማ እየገሰገሰ መሆኑ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Israa'el kibba Libaanoositti magaallota garaa garaa irratti haleellaa qilleensaarraa fi meeshaa gurguddaa ta'e banuu itti fufeera. Haleellaa kana keessatti dhohiinsa gurguddaan kan dhaga'ame yoo ta'u, xiyyaarota waraanaa fi dirooniin naannichatti balali'aa turaniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, waraanni Israa'el gara magaalaa Hadaataatti imaluu jalqabeera.

title: ‘They’re all catastrophic’: The paediatric war wounds Dr Abu Sittah tries to heal in Lebanon
english: British-Palestinian surgeon Dr. Ghassan Abu Sittah is treating numerous children in Beirut suffering from severe, life-altering injuries caused by recent conflicts in Lebanon and Gaza. Many of these young patients, such as the survivors of an airstrike on a family home in Libbaya, require multiple complex reconstructive surgeries to address amputations, burns, and shrapnel wounds. Dr. Abu Sittah continues to work tirelessly through his medical fund to provide these children with the necessary operations and rehabilitation for their long-term recovery.
amharic: ብሪታንያዊው ፍልስጤማዊ የቀዶ ጥገና ሐኪም ዶክተር ጋሳን አቡ ሲታ በሊባኖስ እና በጋዛ በቅርቡ በተካሄዱ ጦርነቶች ምክንያት ለከባድ እና ለዘለቄታው ጉዳት ለተዳረጉ ሕፃናት በቤሩት የሕክምና እርዳታ እየሰጡ ይገኛሉ። ከእነዚህ ታካሚዎች መካከል በሊባያ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት የተረፉት ልጆች የሚገኙበት ሲሆን፣ የሰውነት አካል መጉደልን፣ ከባድ ቃጠሎን እና በተለያዩ የሰውነት ክፍሎች የተሰኩ የጦር መሳሪያ ፍርስራሾችን ለማከም ውስብስብ የቀዶ ጥገና ሕክምናዎችን እየተከታተሉ ነው። ዶክተር አቡ ሲታ እነዚህ ሕፃናት ተገቢውን የሕክምና ድጋፍ እና የመልሶ ማቋቋሚያ አገልግሎት እንዲያገኙ በራሳቸው የሕክምና ፈንድ አማካይነት ጥረታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Ogeessi baqaqsanii hodhuu kan biyya Britaniyaa fi Filisxeem kan ta'an Dr. Ghassan Abu Sittah, waraana Libaanoos fi Gaaza keessatti miidhaa cimaa fi bara baraan isaan irratti hafu irra ga'eef yeroo ammaa Beeyruutitti yaala taasisaaf jiru. Ijoolleen miidhaan kun irra ga'e kun keessumaa haleellaa qilleensaa ganda Libaayaa keessatti raawwatameen booda, miidhaa qaamaa fi gubannoo akkasumas kutaalee meeshaa waraanaa qaama isaanii keessatti hafan baasuuf hojii baqaqsanii hodhuu baay'ee walxaxaa ta'e barbaadu. Dr. Abu Sittah ijoolleen kunneen yaala barbaachisaa ta'e akka argatan fi gara jireenya isaanii isa duraatti deebi'uuf gargaarsa taasisuu isaanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: 'Unprecedented' rains in Japan kill four people
english: Japan's Chiba prefecture experienced record-breaking, life-threatening rainfall that resulted in four deaths and left several others injured. The storm triggered severe flooding and landslides, causing power outages for thousands of homes and major transportation disruptions, including flight delays at Narita Airport. Local authorities issued the highest level of emergency warnings as they continue rescue operations despite the weather conditions beginning to stabilize.
amharic: በጃፓን ቺባ ግዛት በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ እና ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ዝናብ ምክንያት አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ ሌሎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ዝናቡ ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ መጥለቅለቅ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት በማስከተሉ በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶች ኤሌክትሪክ አጥተዋል፤ የአውሮፕላን በረራዎችን ጨምሮ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎቶችም ተስተጓጉለዋል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ከፍተኛውን የአደጋ ማስጠንቀቂያ በማውጣት የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Naannoo Chiba kan biyya Jaappaanitti roobni cimaan guyyoota darban keessa roobe lubbuu namoota afurii galaafateera, namoonni biroos miidhamaniiru. Roobni kun lolaa cimaa fi lafti akka guuru waan godheef, manneen kumaatamaan lakka'aman humna ibsaa malee hafaniru, akkasumas geejjibni xiyyaaraa fi daandiin addaan citeera. Mootummaan biyyattii akeekkachiisa yeroo muddamaa olaanaa labsuun hojiin oolchuu fi gargaarsaa akka itti fufu taasiseera.

title: Flock adds safeguards to licence-plate readers after wave of stalking cases
english: Flock Safety is implementing new privacy measures for its license-plate reading cameras following reports that several police officers used the technology to stalk and harass women. The company is reducing the standard time it stores vehicle data and will now require specific case codes for all searches to prevent unauthorized access. Additionally, the system will feature automated alerts for suspicious search patterns and allow agencies to restrict which data can be shared with others.
amharic: የፍሎክ ሴፍቲ ኩባንያ የመኪና ታርጋ አንባቢ ካሜራዎቹን ፖሊሶች ለግል ጉዳይ እና ለስለላ መጠቀማቸው በታወቀበት ወቅት አዲስ ጥብቅ የደህንነት እርምጃዎችን አስተዋውቋል። ኩባንያው የመረጃ ማቆያ ጊዜውን በማሳጠር እና እያንዳንዱ የፍለጋ ስራ በይፋዊ የክስ መዝገብ ቁጥር እንዲያዝ በማድረግ ያልተገባ አጠቃቀምን ለመከላከል ወስኗል። እንዲሁም አጠራጣሪ የፍለጋ እንቅስቃሴዎችን በራስ-ሰር የሚጠቁም እና ለሌሎች አካላት የሚጋራውን መረጃ የሚገድብ አዲስ ስርዓት ተግባራዊ አድርጓል።
oromo: Kampaniin Flock Safety jedhamu kaameraawwan isaa kanneen lakkoofsa gabatee konkolaataa dubbisan poolisoonni haala seeraan alaa ta'een dubartoota hordofuuf itti fayyadamaa turuu isaanii erga gabaafamee booda, tarkaanfiiwwan eegumsa iccitii haarawaa fudhateera. Kampaniin kun yeroo ragaaleen konkolaataa itti kuufaman akka gabaabbatu kan godhe yoo ta'u, barbaacha kamuuf ragaa seeraa (case codes) akka barbaachisu taasiseera. Dabalataanis, sirnichi gochawwan shakkisiisoo ta'an ofumaan kan akeekkachiisu fi ragaaleen garabiraatti darban daangeeffamuu akka danda'an sirreeffama taasiseera.

title: North Korea fumes over upcoming US-South Korea military drills
english: North Korea has strongly condemned upcoming joint military exercises between the United States and South Korea, labeling them as a provocative escalation that brings the region closer to nuclear conflict. The scheduled 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' drills will focus on modern warfare threats, including cyberattacks and drone operations. In response, Pyongyang has threatened to strengthen its military deterrent, claiming that the alliance between the US, South Korea, and Japan now functions as a nuclear-armed bloc.
amharic: ሰሜን ኮሪያ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በደቡብ ኮሪያ መካከል ሊደረግ የታቀደውን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ አጥብቃ በመቃወም፣ ይህም አካባቢውን ወደ ኒውክሌር ጦርነት አፋፍ የሚያደርስ ቅስቀሳ ነው ስትል ከሳለች። 'ኡልቺ ፍሪደም ሺልድ' ተብሎ የሚጠራው የዘንድሮው ልምምድ በሳይበር ጥቃቶች እና በድሮን ቴክኖሎጂዎች ላይ ያተኩራል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። ለዚህ ምላሽ በሰጠችው መግለጫ ፒዮንግያንግ፣ የሰሜን ኮሪያን የደህንነት ስጋት ለመመከት ወታደራዊ አቅሟን እንደምታሳድግ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Koreaan Kaabaa leenjii waraanaa gama gamanaan Yuunaayitid Isteetes fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa gidduutti taasifamuuf jiru balaaleffatteetti. Leenjiin kun naannichaa gara waraana niwuukilaaraatti akka dhiyeessu ibsuun, hanga 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' jedhamu kanatti of eeggannoo cimaa akka gootu beeksisteetti. Leenjiin waraanaa kunis tajaajila sayberii fi teknolojii doroonii irratti xiyyeeffata jedhameera. Koreaan Kaabaa gamasaatiin, dhiibbaa kana hunda ofirraa ittisuuf qophiin waraanaa ishee akka dabalu ibsiteetti.

title: Fear and attacks grip Taybeh, the last all-Christian town in the West Bank
english: Residents of Taybeh, the final remaining Christian town in the occupied West Bank, are living in constant fear due to escalating attacks and intimidation by Israeli settlers. Families have adopted nightly safety routines, and local business owners have suffered massive financial losses after their properties were vandalized and raided by armed groups. These coordinated assaults have disrupted daily life, leaving children traumatized and residents feeling unprotected as they face increasing threats to their homes and livelihoods.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ የመጨረሻዋ የክርስትና እምነት ተከታዮች ከተማ የሆነችው ታይቤ ነዋሪዎች በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰሪዎች በሚሰነዘርባቸው ጥቃት እና ማስፈራሪያ በከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ለደህንነታቸው ሲሉ የሌሊት ጥበቃን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የጥንቃቄ እርምጃዎችን በመውሰድ ላይ ሲሆኑ፣ የንግድ ስራ ባለቤቶችም በታጠቁ ቡድኖች ንብረታቸው በመውደሙ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። እነዚህ የተቀናጁ ጥቃቶች የህጻናትን የአእምሮ ሰላም በመንሳትና የነዋሪዎችን የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮ በማወክ የደህንነት ስሜትን አሳጥተዋል።
oromo: Magaalaan Taybeh jedhamtu kan bulchiinsa lafa qabame (West Bank) keessatti argamtu, jiraattonni Kiristaanotaa weerara fi doorsisa gidiraa irraa gahuun jireenya soda keessa jiru. Maatiin fi abbootin qabeenyaa weerara hidhattootaan qabeenyisaanii manca’e fi miidhaa guddaa irra gahee jira. Hojiin guyyuu fi tasgabbiin maatii fi ijoollee kan booressu ta’ee, jiraattonni eegumsa dhabuun rakkoo jireenyaa hamaa keessa akka jiran himu.

title: Record rainfall leaves four dead, thousands stranded in Japan
english: Record-breaking rainfall in Japan's Chiba prefecture has resulted in at least four deaths and significant travel disruptions during the busy Bon holiday week. Flooding caused widespread power outages for over 22,000 households and left thousands of people stranded at train stations and airports. Emergency teams and the military are currently assisting with relief efforts as authorities urge residents in affected areas to seek shelter.
amharic: በጃፓን ቺባ ግዛት የጣለው ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ዝናብ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን በበዓል ወቅት የሚጓዙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችንም ለችግር ዳርጓል። ጎርፉ ከ22,000 በላይ ቤቶች የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይል እንዲቋረጥባቸው ያደረገ ሲሆን በባቡር ጣቢያዎችና በአውሮፕላን ማረፊያዎች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ መንገደኞች ተቸግረዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሠራተኞችና ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በቦታው ተሰማርተው ድጋፍ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ባለሥልጣናትም ነዋሪዎች ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉና ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ቦታ እንዲጠለሉ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Japoon, naannoo Chiba keessatti roobni cimaan roobee lubbuun namoota afur yoo darbu, namoota kumaatamaan lakka'aman imala isaanii irratti rakkinaaf saaxileera. Balaan lolaa kun manneen jireenyaa 22,000 ol irratti humna elektirikii kan kutate yoo ta'u, namoonni baay'eenis buufata baaburaa fi buufata xiyyaaraa keessatti qabamaniiru. Gareen gargaarsaa fi waraanni hojii fayyinsaa irratti bobba'anii kan jiran yoo ta'u, aantonni mootummaa namoota naannoo sana jiran tasgabbii fi bakka nageenya qabu akka barbaadan gorsaniiru.

title: JD Vance says low energy prices for Americans top priority amid US war on Iran
english: US Vice President JD Vance stated that the administration's primary goal during the conflict with Iran is to maintain affordable energy costs for American citizens. While acknowledging that oil prices have recently decreased, he emphasized that keeping fuel prices low remains his top priority. Additionally, he noted that preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons is a key national security objective.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከኢራን ጋር በሚደረገው ግጭት ወቅት የአሜሪካ መንግስት ቀዳሚ ትኩረት ለዜጎቹ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲረጋጋ ማድረግ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከቀድሞው ማሽቆልቆሉን ቢገልጹም፣ ዝቅተኛ ዋጋን ማስጠበቅ ዋነኛ አላማቸው መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ መከላከል ለሀገሪቱ ሌላው ወሳኝ ጉዳይ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, waraana Iraan waliin jiru keessatti dursi inni guddaan gatiin boba'aa lammiilee Ameerikaaf gatii madaalawaa ta'ee akka itti fufu taasisuudha. Gatiin boba'aa amansiisoo ta'ee akka itti fufu gochuun immoo galma isaanii isa tokkoffaa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Iraan meeshaa niwukilaaraa akka hin arganne ittisuun dhimma nageenya biyyoolessaa isa ijoo ta'uu eeraniiru.

title: US Senator Schumer calls for firing of Hegseth over handling of aircraft carrier
english: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer has formally requested the immediate dismissal of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Schumer claims that Hegseth’s poor management of the USS Abraham Lincoln has put American sailors in serious danger. He labeled the official as incompetent and insisted that his leadership is directly responsible for the current crisis.

Kanaafuu, ministeerri kun yeroo ammaa hatattamaan hojiirraa bu'uu qaba jedhaniiru.

title: Centcom denies reports of soldiers dying onboard the USS Abraham Lincoln
english: The U.S. Central Command has officially dismissed recent online rumors claiming that sailors died aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln during its current deployment. Officials clarified that no fatalities have occurred on the aircraft carrier, specifically labeling reports of a deadly fight and increased suicides as completely false. They also confirmed that a single sailor who fell into the sea on August 3 was rescued successfully and is safe.

Kana malees, qondaaltoonni kun ganna darbe guyyaa Hagayya 3 doonii sana irraa kan kufe loltuun tokko saffisaan fayyadamanii lubbuun oolchuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Christopher Nolan remakes 'The Odyssey' as an Anglo-American imperial fantasy
english: Director Christopher Nolan’s new film adaptation of The Odyssey has premiered, featuring stars like Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway. The film has drawn criticism for its grandiose, imperialistic approach to Greek history, with observers arguing that it promotes a westernized narrative that alienates modern Greeks from their own cultural heritage. Critics suggest that Nolan’s focus on massive cinematic scale obscures the genuine historical and geographical roots of the original epic.

Fiilmichi seenaa Giriikii akkaataa 'Lixaatti' (Western) fayyadamuun dhiyeessuu fi eenyummaa dhugaa uummata Giriikii laaffisa jechuun komatameera. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, Nolaan fiilmiicharratti teeknooloojii gurguddaa fayyadamuun isaa, hiikaa fi seenaa dhugaa suuraa sanaa akka dhoksuu fi dogoggorsu dubbatu.

title: Watch: Turkey's Fidan warns of 'radical steps' if Israel does not comply with Gaza deal
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has stated that Turkey, along with Egypt and Qatar, might implement major measures if the U.S. fails to push Israel to honor the Gaza ceasefire agreement. He noted that while Palestinian representatives have met their obligations, Israel has stalled in moving forward with the second stage of the deal. Fidan is calling on the United States to use its influence to ensure Israel follows through with the necessary commitments.

Kanaafuu, Ameerikaan Israa'el waadaa ishee akka kabajju dhiibbaa gochuu akka qabdu ministirichi gaafataniiru.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is deeply rooted in a social culture that prioritizes absolute obedience over open dialogue. This hierarchical mindset begins at home and in schools, where questioning authority is often viewed as a sign of disrespect or disloyalty. As a result, these patterns of submission and dominance carry over into workplaces and government institutions, preventing the critical thinking necessary for a healthy democratic society.

title: Salvage work begins on tanker leaking oil off Oman, risk firm says
english: A salvage operation has started to stabilize an oil tanker that has been leaking crude off the coast of Oman since June. The ship, suspected of being part of Russia’s shadow fleet, has caused a massive oil spill that is now polluting local beaches and threatening the environment. Despite difficult monsoon weather, international experts are working with Omani authorities to secure the vessel and contain the damage.

title: Water supply for three US states drips down, Lake Mead at record low
english: Lake Mead, the largest reservoir in the United States, has reached an unprecedented low water level. Located between Nevada and Arizona, its decline by two-thirds threatens the water and electricity supply for millions of people. This crisis highlights the severe impact on resources across the western part of the country.

title: Brazil begins exploring retaliatory options to new US tariffs
english: The Brazilian government has begun formal consultations to consider retaliatory measures against the United States in response to new 25 percent tariffs imposed on various Brazilian exports. While no final decision has been reached, Brazil is exploring options such as taxing American imports or suspending certain patents to protect its economy. This move follows the US government's claims of unfair trade practices, which Brazil maintains are unjustified and arbitrary.

title: Mali says 82 soldiers captured by armed groups have been freed
english: The Malian military recently announced that 82 of its soldiers, who had been held captive by armed rebel groups in the northern part of the country, have been released. These troops were freed following mediation efforts by Algeria for humanitarian reasons, though there are conflicting reports regarding how long the individuals were held. While these soldiers are now safe under government care, rebel organizations claim that many others still remain in captivity.

oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Maalii, loltoonni isaanii 82 kanneen kaaba biyyattii keessatti gareewwan hidhatanin qabamanii turan gadi lakkifamuu isaanii beeksiseera. Loltoonni kunniin sababa namoomaatiin fi giddu-galeessummaa biyya Aljeeriyaatiin kan gadi lakkifaman yoo ta'u, yeroo dheeraa hidhamanii turan irratti mootummaa fi gareewwan hidhatan gidduutti yaanni wal-hin fakkaanne jira. Loltoonni kunniin amma nageenyi isaanii eegamee qaama mootummaa harka kan jiran ta'us, gareewwan hidhatan garuu loltoonni biroo hedduun ammallee hidhaa keessa akka jiran dubbatu.

title: Turkey's foreign minister accuses Israel of expelling Palestinians from Gaza
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has accused Israel of planning to forcibly remove all Palestinians from the Gaza Strip. During a meeting in Egypt, Fidan criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies as inhumane and called for urgent international pressure to stop the ongoing conflict. He also claimed that Turkey and Egypt have collaborated to mitigate the violence, even as Israeli military operations in the region continue.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Turkii Haakan Fidaan, Israa'el warra Falastiin hunda Gaazaa keessaa arii'uuf karoora qabdi jechuun himatan. Misiritti haasaa taasisaniin, siyaasni Muummee Ministiraa Benjaamin Netaanyaahuu namummaa kan tuqu dha jechuun, walitti bu'insa kana dhaabsisuuf dhiibbaan idil-addunyaa akka godhamu gaafatan. Kana malees, Turkii fi Misir walitti bu'insa kana hir'isuuf waliin hojjechaa akka jiran ibsaniiru.

title: Kushner expected to travel to Israel for Gaza talks next week: Report
english: Jared Kushner, serving as a Middle East envoy for President Trump, is planning a trip to Israel next week. The primary goal of his visit is to hold talks regarding the long-term future of Gaza. He intends to discuss strategies to further the progress of the administration's peace initiative for the region.
amharic: የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ አማች እና የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ የሆኑት ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት እስራኤልን እንደሚጎበኙ ተዘግቧል። ጉብኝታቸው በዋናነት የሚያተኩረው የጋዛን የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ለመወሰን በሚደረጉ ውይይቶች ላይ ነው። ኩሽነር በአካባቢው ሰላም ለማምጣት የታቀደውን ዕቅድ ቀጣይ እርምጃዎች ለመወያየት አቅደዋል።
oromo: Ergamtoota pirezidaant Traamp kan ta'an Jaared Kushner torban dhufu gara Israa'el akka imalan gabaafameera. Imalli isaanii kun haala gara fuulduraa Gaazaa irratti mari'achuuf kan yaadame dha. Innis karoora nageenyaa naannichaa fiduuf qophaa'e ilaalchisee tarkaanfiiwwan itti aanan irratti akka mari'atu eegama.

title: Vance says US will end up 'in a stronger position' than Iran
english: US Vice President JD Vance announced that the administration is utilizing a strategic mix of military, economic, and diplomatic tools to exert pressure on Iran. He criticized the Iranian government for failing to uphold its previous agreements and expressed confidence that current US actions will ultimately ensure Iran does not acquire nuclear weapons. Furthermore, he emphasized that these measures are intended to restore open access to the Strait of Hormuz and secure a dominant position for the United States.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ፣ አገራቸው ኢራን ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር ወታደራዊ፣ ኢኮኖሚያዊ እና ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስልቶችን እየተጠቀመች እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። የኢራን መንግስት ቀደም ሲል የገባቸውን ቃል እንደማያከብር የጠቆሙት ቫንስ፣ የአሜሪካ ጥረት ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝና በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ ያላትን ተጽዕኖ ለመቀነስ እንደሚያስችል ተናግረዋል። በመጨረሻም እነዚህን ስልቶች በመጠቀም አሜሪካ ከኢራን የበለጠ ጠንካራ አቋም እንደምትይዝ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance, mootummaan isaanii dhiibbaa Iran irratti geessisuuf mala waraanaa, dinagdee fi dippilomaasii walitti makuun itti fayyadamaa akka jiru ibsan. Mootummaan Iran kakuu kanaan dura gale hin kabajne jedhanii, tarkaanfiin yeroo ammaa fudhatamaa jiru kun Iran meeshaa niwuukilaraa akka hin arganneef akka gargaaru dubbatan. Kana malees, mala kana fayyadamuun Ameerikaan bakka bu'iinsa Hormuz banuufi sadarkaa cimaa irra akka ga'u abdii akka qaban ibsaniiru.

title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
english: The White House has released a report claiming that over 40 countries, including Canada and India, have helped China bypass US tariffs by rerouting its goods through their borders. This practice, known as transshipping, allegedly costs the US billions in revenue and threatens American jobs by masking the true origin of Chinese products. In response, China has criticized these trade restrictions and emphasized that such unilateral actions harm global trade interests.

oromo: Mana Maree Adii (White House) gabaasa baaseen, biyyoonni 40 ol ta’an kanneen akka Kaanaadaa fi Indiyaa, Chaayinaan gibira Ameerikaa irraa fagaachuuf akka gargaaran ibseera. Chaayinaan meeshaalee ishee biyyoota biraatiin darbanii fi maqaa biroo qabatanii akka gara Ameerikaatti galan gochuudhaan gibira hir’ifachuu ishee gabaasichi ni ibsa. Chaayinaan gama isheen, tarkaanfiin kun sirrii akka hin taane fi waraanni daldalaa bu’aa kan hin qabne ta’uu ibsuudhaan, mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiibbaa kana akka dhaabu gaafatteetti.

title: Why Osun’s election matters for Nigeria’s 2027 vote
english: The upcoming gubernatorial election in Osun State is viewed as a critical test of voter sentiment and political influence ahead of Nigeria’s 2027 presidential race. While the vote focuses on local leadership, it serves as an indicator of whether President Bola Tinubu’s party can maintain its stronghold in the southwest region. The outcome will demonstrate if the ruling party’s strategy of gaining support through political defections truly resonates with voters at the polls.
amharic: በኦሱን ግዛት ሊካሄድ የታቀደው የገዢነት ምርጫ የናይጄሪያን የ2027 የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ መንፈስ እና የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ለመለካት እንደ ወሳኝ ፈተና ይታያል። ምርጫው በክልል ደረጃ አመራርን የመምረጥ ዓላማ ቢኖረውም፣ የፕሬዝዳንት ቦላ ቲኑቡ ፓርቲ በደቡብ ምዕራብ ክልል ያለውን ተቀባይነት ለመገምገም እንደ መለኪያ ያገለግላል። የውጤቱ መፈታት ገዢው ፓርቲ በፖለቲካዊ ሽግግሮች የሚያገኘው ድጋፍ ከሕዝቡ በእርግጥ ድምጽ ሊያስገኝለት እንደሚችል ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoon bulchaa naannoo Osun godhamuuf jiru, filannoo prezidaantummaa Naayijeeriyaa kan bara 2027 dura fedhii fi humna siyaasaa uummataa madaaluuf akka qormaata guddaatti ilaalama. Filannichi ofiin isaatii kan naannoo ta'us, gareen Prezidaant Bola Tinuubuu naannoo kibba-dhihaa keessatti humni isaa ammas cimaa ta'uu isaa beekuuf gargaara. Bu'aan filannoo kanaa gareen bulchaa jiru kun jijjiirraa siyaasaan argatu kun dhugumatti deggeraalee uummataa irraa deggersa akka argatu kan mirkaneessu ta'a.

title: UN, Palestinian ministry condemn Israeli settler siege of West Bank homes
english: The United Nations and the Palestinian Foreign Ministry have strongly condemned an ongoing siege by Israeli settlers against three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra. For several days, these families have been trapped in their homes without access to water or electricity, amid accusations that the settlers are trying to force them off their land. International officials and Palestinian authorities have labeled these actions as criminal and terroristic, warning that the goal is the illegal displacement of the residents.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እና የፍልስጤም የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር በሦስት የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች ላይ በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች እየተደረገ ያለውን ከበባ አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። እነዚህ ቤተሰቦች ለቀናት ያህል ውኃ እና ኤሌክትሪክ ሳይኖራቸው በቤታቸው ታግደው የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ ሰፋሪዎቹ ከምድራቸው ለማፈናቀል እየሞከሩ ነው የሚል ክስ ቀርቧል። ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት እና የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት ወንጀለኛ እና ሽብርተኝነት መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ የነዋሪዎቹን በግዳጅ የማፈናቀል አላማ እንዳለው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fi Ministeerri Dhimmi Alaa Philaasxiim, gandoota Qusraa kan Lixaa Baankii (West Bank) keessatti gandoonni Israa'el maatiiwwan Philaasxiim sadan irratti marsaa gaggeessaa jiran jabeessee balaaleffateera. Maatiiwwan kunneen guyyoota muraasaaf bishaanii fi ibsaa malee mana isaanii keessatti hidhamanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, qe'ee isaanii irraa isaan buqqisuuf yaalii godhamaa jiruun himatamu. Qaamoleen idil-addunyaa fi bulchiinsi Philaasxiim gochi kun yakka fi shororkeessummaa ta'uu ibsuun, kaayyoon isaa maatiiwwan kunneen dirqamaan buqqisuu akka ta'e akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Could Trump actually run for a third term as president?
english: Although Donald Trump has occasionally teased the possibility of serving more than two terms as U.S. president, he acknowledges that current laws prevent this. The U.S. Constitution strictly limits presidents to two terms in office. Despite his rhetoric, there is no legal pathway for him to seek a third term.

oromo: Donald Trump yeroo tokko tokko yeroo lamatti booda pirezidaantummaa Ameerikaa itti fufuuf fedhii qabaachuu isaa himus, seera amma jiruun kun akka hin danda'amne beeka. Haasaa isaa keessatti yoo kaase illee, yeroo sadaffaaf akka filatamuuf gadi ba'uuf seeraan karaa baname hin jiru.

title: Bodycam captures lightning striking metres from US police officers
english: A bodycam video recorded the startling moment lightning struck extremely close to South Dakota state troopers. The officers were chasing a suspect on foot when the incident occurred. Fortunately, none of the police personnel were harmed by the lightning strike.
amharic: በደቡብ ዳኮታ የሀይዌይ ፓትሮል መኮንኖች አንድን ተጠርጣሪ በእግር ሲያሳድዱ የነበረበት የሰውነት ካሜራ በአቅራቢያቸው የተከሰተውን የመብረቅ አደጋ ቀርጿል። መብረቁ የተከሰተው መኮንኖቹ ካሉበት ጥቂት ሜትሮች ርቀት ላይ ቢሆንም፣ በደረሰው አደጋ ማንም የፖሊስ አባል ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Viidiyoon kaameeraa qaamaa irratti hidhattee jirtu, poolisoonni South Dakota bakka tokkotti namoota shakku tokko hordofaa utuu jiranii qaqqaawwee xiyyeeffannoo uummataa hawwate agarsiiseetti. Qaqqaawween kun poolisoota kanneen irraa meetira muraasa qofa fagaatee kan bu'e yoo ta'u, gama isaaniitiin miidhaan qaamaa tokkollee irra hin geenye.

title: Talks between government and opposition mark a new chapter for Venezuela
english: The Venezuelan government and opposition parties recently concluded a historic round of talks aimed at addressing the nation's severe economic and political crises. The two sides reached a preliminary agreement to recover frozen international assets to fund earthquake relief and to significantly overhaul the country's judiciary system. While citizens like teachers and pensioners are cautiously optimistic about these reforms, many remain vigilant, calling for continued pressure to ensure genuine change.
amharic: የቬንዙዌላ መንግስት እና የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲዎች ሀገሪቱን እያመሰ ያለውን ኢኮኖሚያዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ችግሮች ለመፍታት ታሪካዊ ውይይት አድርገዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በውጭ ሀገራት የታገዱ ንብረቶችን ለተፈጥሮ አደጋ መከላከል ለማዋል እና የፍትህ ስርዓቱን በስፋት ለማሻሻል ተስማምተዋል። በሀገሪቱ ያሉ ሰራተኞች እና ጡረተኞች ለውጡን በጉጉት ቢጠባበቁም፣ እውነተኛ መሻሻል ለማምጣት ተከታታይ ክትትል እንደሚያስፈልግ በመግለጽ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan Venzuweelaa fi gareen mormituu biyyattii rakkoo diinagdee fi siyaasaa biyyattii mudate furuuf marii seena qabeessa ta'e tokko xumuraniiru. Gareen kunneen qabeenya alatti qabame deebifachuun gargaarsa hatattamaaf oolchuu fi sirna haqaa biyyattii jijjiiruuf waliigalteerra gahuu danda'aniiru. Hawaasni fi hojjettoonni biyyattii jijjiirama kanaaf abdii kan qaban ta'us, jijjiiramni dhugaan akka dhufuuf hordoffii cimaa gochuun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru.

title: Israeli army fired at civilians in Syria's Daraa province
english: Syrian state media reported that Israeli military forces shot at civilians in the Daraa province. The attack caused residents in the village of Maariya to flee their homes for safety. Fortunately, there have been no confirmed reports of casualties following this incident.
amharic: የሶሪያ የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሶሪያ ዳራ ግዛት በሚኖሩ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ላይ ተኩስ መክፈታቸውን ዘግበዋል። በዚህ ጥቃት ምክንያት የማሪያ መንደር ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲሰደዱ ተገደዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ በደረሰው ጉዳት የሟቾች ወይም የቆሰሉ ሰዎች መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Suuriyaa akka gabaasanitti, loltoonni Israa'eel naannoo Daaraa keessatti namoota nagaa irratti dhukaasa bananii jiru. Dhukaasa kanaan kan ka'e, jiraattoonni baadiyaa Maariyaa jedhamu irraa buqqa'uun dirqamanii jiru. Gabaasni lubbuun darbe ykn miidhaan qaamaa ga'e hanga ammaatti hin jiru.

title: Report: Iraqi air defences intercept drones over Erbil
english: Iraqi defense systems successfully shot down multiple drones near the airport in Erbil early Thursday morning. Parts of the destroyed drones landed in a nearby neighborhood, but fortunately, no one was harmed during the incident. Authorities have confirmed that there are no reported injuries or fatalities resulting from the attempt.
amharic: የኢራቅ የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊት እሮብ እለት ማለዳ ላይ በአርቢል አየር ማረፊያ አቅራቢያ የሚበሩ ድሮኖችን መትቶ ጥሏል። የተደመሰሱት ድሮኖች ስብርባሪዎች በመኖሪያ አካባቢ ላይ ቢወድቁም፣ በሰዎች ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በክስተቱ ምክንያት የተጎዳ ሰው የለም።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa qilleensaa Iraaq guyyaa Kamisaa ganama naannoo buufata xiyyaaraa Erbilitti xiyyaara malee feettuu (drones) tokko tokko rukutee kuseera. Xiyyaara kanneen irraa kan hafe bakka namoonni jiraatanitti kan kufe ta'us, namni miidhame hin jiru. Aangeyyoonni akka ibsanitti, haala kanaan miidhaan lubbuus ta'e qaamaa namoota irra hin ga'e.

title: Israeli forces will not withdraw from south Lebanon or Gaza, Katz says
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has declared that the country's military will maintain its presence in designated security zones within southern Lebanon and Gaza. This statement contradicts a recent agreement that conditioned an Israeli withdrawal on the disarmament of Hezbollah. The United States has criticized the minister's position, noting that it conflicts with Israel's prior commitments.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ የእስራኤል ጦር በደቡብ ሊባኖስ እና በጋዛ በሚገኙ የደህንነት ቀጠናዎች ውስጥ መቆየቱን እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ እስራኤል ከሊባኖስ የምትወጣው ሂዝቦላህ ትጥቅ ሲፈታ ነው በሚለው የቅርብ ጊዜ ስምምነት ላይ ጥላ አጥልቷል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት ይህ የካቲዝ አቋም እስራኤል ቀደም ብላ የገባችውን ቃል የሚቃረን ነው በማለት ተችቶታል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, waraanni isaanii naannolee nageenyaa jedhamanii moggaafaman kan kibba Libaanoosii fi Gaazaatii akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Ibsi kun walii galtee kanaan dura Israa'el harka fuudhiinsa hidhannoo Hizbullaatiin walqabatee Libaanoosii ba'uuf galame faallaa kan dhaabbatuudha. Mootummaan Ameerikaa, yaada ministirichaa kana ibsi Israa'el kanaan dura galtee turte kan faallessuudha jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Bessent says US set to apply measures never seen on Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the United States is preparing to implement unprecedented economic sanctions against Iran. These measures, expected to be revealed next week, aim to achieve total economic isolation. The plan also includes a strict blockade of the Strait of Hormuz to stop all maritime trade involving Iranian ports.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ከዚህ በፊት ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ማቀዷን አስታውቀዋል። በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት ይፋ እንደሚደረጉ የሚጠበቁት እነዚህ እርምጃዎች፣ ኢራንን ሙሉ ለሙሉ ከዓለም ኢኮኖሚ ለመነጠል ያለሙ ናቸው። በተጨማሪም በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ላይ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር በማድረግ ወደ ኢራን ወደቦች የሚደረግ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን ለማቆም አቅደዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqaa Amerikaa Iskooti Beseent akka jedhanitti, Amerikaan Iran irratti tarkaanfii dinagdee kanaan dura hin mul'anne fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jirti. Tarkaanfiiwwan torban dhufu ifoomuuf jiran kun, Iran addunyaa irraa guutummaatti addaan baasuuf kan kaayyeffatan dha. Karoorri kun daldalli bakkeewwan Iran keessa akka hin darbineef galaana Hormuz irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuu kan of keessatti qabatu dha.

title: Israeli defence minister inaugurates new illegal settlement in Jenin
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz recently opened a new settlement in the Jenin region of the occupied West Bank. This move occurred on the same day that Israeli forces destroyed various Palestinian-owned shops and properties. Although Katz acknowledged that settler violence negatively impacts Israel's international reputation, the government continues to expand illegal settlements across Palestinian territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ጀኒን አካባቢ አዲስ ሰፈራ መመስረታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የፍልስጤም ባለቤትነት ያላቸውን ሱቆች እና ንብረቶች ካወደሙበት ዕለት ጋር ነው። ካትዝ በአዲሱ ሰፈራ ምክንያት የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት በእስራኤል ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ እስራኤል በፍልስጤም ግዛቶች ውስጥ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎችን ማስፋፋቷን ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz naannoo Jenin kan bakka qabamee jiru West Bank keessatti qubannaa haaraa bananiiru. Tarkaanfin kun guyyaa waraanni Israa'el qabeenyaa fi suuqiiwwan warra Filisxeemii mancaasanii dha. Ministirichi miidhaan qubattootaan gahu sun biyya Israa'el irratti dhiibbaa hamaa akka qabu hubachiisanis, mootummaan Israa'el lafa Filisxeemii keessatti qubannaa seeraan alaa babal'isuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: UAE accuses Iran of attacks on two ADNOC vessels in Strait of Hormuz
english: The United Arab Emirates has accused Iran of attacking two oil tankers belonging to its national company while they were passing through the Strait of Hormuz. Although no injuries were reported, the UAE condemned these hostile acts as piracy and a significant threat to global energy stability. This incident follows a series of similar attacks on vessels in the region amid ongoing tensions and blockades between Iran and the United States.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ሲያልፉ የነበሩ ሁለት የነዳጅ መርከቦቿ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን ከሰሰች። ምንም እንኳን በሰው ላይ የደረሰ ጉዳት ባይኖርም፣ ኤሚሬቶች ድርጊቱን የባህር ላይ ወንበዴነት እና ለአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ ደህንነት ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጻለች። ይህ ጥቃት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ባለው ውጥረት እና በተፈጠረው የባህር መተላለፊያ እገዳ ምክንያት የተፈጠሩ ተከታታይ ግጭቶች አካል ነው።
oromo: Emirates Arabaa Gamtoomte, dooniiwwan boba'aa kan kambanii biyyattii lama ta'an gara hargantoo Hormuz darbuu isaanii irratti Iran haleellaa raawwatte jechuun himatteetti. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuu kan hin qaqqabne ta'us, biyyattiin gocha kana saaminsa galaana fi xalayaa nageenya anniisaa addunyaa irra jiru irratti yaaddoo guddaa qabuun balaaleffatteetti. Haleellaan kun dhiibbaa fi duula galaana irratti Itoophiyaa fi Ameerikaa gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru keessatti kan uumame yoo ta'u, miidhaan gosa kanaa yeroo dhihoo as deddeebi'ee kan mudatuu dha.

title: Yemen faces highest risk of returning to war since 2022 truce, UN warns
english: The United Nations has warned that Yemen is facing its greatest risk of returning to full-scale war since the 2022 truce began. Fighting between Houthi rebels and government forces has intensified recently, resulting in both military and civilian casualties across several regions. The UN envoy is urging all sides to de-escalate, prioritize economic stability, and return to peace negotiations to prevent the crisis from deepening.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በየመን ከ2022 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በኋላ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነት የመቀስቀስ አደጋ እንደተጋረጠ አስጠንቅቋል። በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች እና በመንግስት ሃይሎች መካከል እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት በበርካታ አካባቢዎች የሲቪል እና የወታደር ሞት እያስከተለ ይገኛል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት መልዕክተኛ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ግጭቱን እንዲቀንሱ፣ ለኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ እና የሰላም ንግግሮችን እንዲጀምሩ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa akka ibsetti, Yaman waraana waggaa 2022 taasifame booda hanga ammaatti waraana guddaa irra deebi'ee jalqabamuuf balaa guddaa keessa jirti. Gidduu kana haleellaa fi walitti bu'iinsa garee Huutii fi waraana mootummaa gidduutti taasifameen lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbee jira. Ergamaan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa gamachuun walitti bu'iinsa dhaabuuf, nageenya biyyattii fi guddina dinagdee akka durfanii hojjetan hunda isaaniiyyuu gaafateera.

title: Iran war live: US eyes indefinite Iran naval blockade
english: The United States is considering a long-term naval blockade of Iran as part of its strategy to influence the regional conflict. Vice President JD Vance explained that these actions aim to keep energy prices stable and stop Iran from developing nuclear weapons. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth added that the American military is prepared to maintain this blockade indefinitely to ensure a stronger geopolitical position.
amharic: አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የባህር ላይ እገዳን ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ለመጣል እያሰበች ነው። ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ እንደገለፁት፣ ይህ እርምጃ የኢነርጂ ዋጋን ለማረጋጋት እና ኢራን የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ለመከላከል ያለመ ነው። የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ በበኩላቸው፣ አሜሪካ ጠንካራ አቋም ለመያዝ ይህንን እገዳ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ ለመቀጠል ዝግጁ መሆኗን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Amerikaa garee waraana Iran irratti uggura markaboota yeroo dheeraaf turuu danda'u tokko kaa'uuf karoorfatteetti. Itti-aanaan Preezdaantii JD Vance akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin kun gatii anniisaa tasgabbeessuu fi Iran meeshaa niwukileraa akka hin arganne ittisuuf kan gargaaru dha. Ministirri Ittisaa Pete Hegseth gamasaaniin, Amerikaan iddoo cimaa keessa jiraachuuf uggura kana yeroo barbaadame hunda itti fufsiisuuf qophiidha jedhaniiru.

title: Gaza City police chief killed as Israel pushes on with deadly strikes
english: The head of Gaza City's police force, Colonel Jamal Abu Kamil, was killed in an Israeli drone strike as air raids resumed following a brief pause. Israeli forces claimed the official was a Hamas commander, though this was denied by Gaza police authorities. Additional strikes in Khan Younis and Beit Lahiya have also resulted in further fatalities, marking an escalation despite recent international efforts to maintain a ceasefire.
amharic: የጋዛ ከተማ የፖሊስ ዋና አዛዥ ኮሎኔል ጀማል አቡ ካሚል በእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ተገደሉ። እስራኤል ግለሰቡን የሀማስ አዛዥ ነው በማለት የገደለችው ቢሆንም፣ የጋዛ ፖሊስ ይህንን ክስ አስተባብለዋል። በካን ዩኒስ እና በቤት ላሂያ በተፈጸሙ ሌሎች ጥቃቶች ተጨማሪ ሰዎች መገደላቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ቀደም ሲል የተደረሰው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት አደጋ ላይ ወድቋል።
oromo: Ajajaan poolisii magaalaa Gaaza Kolonel Jamaal Abuu Kaamil xiyyaara nama hin qabneen rukutamee ajjeefameera. Israa'el namni kun hogganaa haamaas ta'uu isaa ibsitee kan ajjeefte ta'us, poolisiin Gaaza himannaa kana haaleera. Godina Kaani Yuunis fi Beet Laahiyaatti weerarawwan biroo gaggeeffamaniin lubbuun namoota kanneen biroo darbuun, carraaqqii tasgabbii fi nagaa fiduuf taasifamaa ture miidheera.

title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
english: A Ryanair flight from Greece to Germany was forced to return to the airport after an engine fan blade broke, sending debris into the cabin window. The impact shattered the glass, partially pulling a passenger through the opening before others helped hold him inside. Investigators are currently reviewing the incident, which occurred despite the engine passing a maintenance inspection only two months earlier.

oromo: Xiyyaarri Raayaan Eer (Ryanair) kan Giriikii gara Jarmanii imalaa ture, kutaaleen injinii isaa cabanii foddaa irratti erga rukutanii booda gara buufata xiyyaaraatti deebi'uuf dirqameera. Cabni injinii sun foddaa cabsee tures, abbaa warraa tokko gara alaatti harkisuu jalqabe; namoonni biroos isa qabuun lubbuun isaa akka hin darbe gargaaraniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa qorannoo godhan, injiniin xiyyaarichaa ji'a lama dura qoratamee kan ture ta'us, sababa rakkoo kanaa adda baasuuf qorannoo gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Tate supporters rally for brothers ahead of bail hearing in Miami
english: Supporters of Andrew and Tristan Tate held a demonstration outside a Miami detention center to demand their release before a bail hearing. The brothers are currently facing potential extradition to the United Kingdom to answer for serious criminal allegations, including sexual assault and human trafficking. Participants at the rally showed their backing for the siblings through chants and physical exercises near the facility.
amharic: የአንድሪው እና ትሪስታን ቴይት ደጋፊዎች የዋስትና ችሎታቸውን አስመልክቶ በማያሚ በሚገኝ ማቆያ ጣቢያ ውጭ ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ወንድማማቾቹ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በድብደባ፣ በጾታዊ ንግድ እና በግፍ ወንጀሎች የተከሰሱ ሲሆን ወደዚያ እንዲላኩ እየተጠባበቁ ነው። የተሰበሰቡት ደጋፊዎች ወንድማማቾቹ እንዲፈቱ በመጠየቅ ድጋፋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Deggertoonni Andrew fi Tristan Tate mana hidhaa Maayamiitti argamuun gadihiinsaa isaanii gaafachuu fi dhaddacha wabii isaanii dura hiriira ba'an. Obboloonni kun UK keessatti himannaa gudeeddii, daldala qaamaa fi miidhaa qaamaa irratti dhihaateen wal qabatee gara achitti ergamuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Hiriirtotni kunneen sagalee dhageessisuu fi qaama isaanii sochii gochuun obboloota kanaaf deggersa qaban agarsiisaniiru.

title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, including police chief
english: Israeli drone strikes in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of two individuals, one of whom was a local police chief. The attack also left several other people injured during the incident on Thursday. This military action follows Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's recent refusal to accept a new peace proposal suggested by US President Donald Trump.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት የፖሊስ አዛዥን ጨምሮ ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። በዚሁ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ያቀረቡትን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ ካደረጉ ቀናት በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el gaaza keessatti xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeesseen ajajaan poolisii tokkoo fi namni biraan tokko du'aniiru. Haleellaa Roobii guyyaa keessa mudate kanaan namoonni biroo hedduunis miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan mudate erga muummichi ministeeraa Beenjaamiin Neetanyaahuu qajeelfama nagaa pirezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp dhiyeessan fudhachuu didanii guyyoota muraasa boodadha.

title: Mexico says Colombia rejected its earthquake rescue team
english: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum claims that Colombia blocked a Mexican military rescue team from assisting with earthquake relief efforts despite their international certification. Colombia denies any political motivation for this decision, stating that they are simply requiring all incoming rescue groups to meet specific UN-backed standards. While the rescue team remains grounded, Colombia confirmed it is still accepting other forms of humanitarian aid, such as food and medical supplies, from Mexico.
amharic: የሜክሲኮ ፕሬዝዳንት ክላውዲያ ሼይንባም ኮሎምቢያ ዓለም አቀፍ እውቅና ያላቸውን የሜክሲኮ የነፍስ አድን ቡድን በምድር ነውጥ አደጋ ወቅት እንዳይረዱ መከልከሏን ተናግረዋል። የኮሎምቢያ መንግስት ይህ ውሳኔ ከፖለቲካ ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው እና የውጭ አገር የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ያወጣውን መስፈርት ማሟላት እንዳለባቸው አስታውቋል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኑ ጉዞ ቢሰረዝም፣ ኮሎምቢያ ከሜክሲኮ የሚመጡ የምግብ እና የህክምና ቁሳቁሶችን እርዳታ መቀበሏን ቀጥላለች።

Gareen fayyisuu kun gara biyyatti akka hin deemne kan dhorkame ta'us, Kolombiyaan gargaarsa nyaataa fi qorichaa biyya Meksikoo irraa dhufe fudhachuu ishee itti fufteetti.

title: Multiple houses ablaze as wildfire sweeps into UK town
english: A large wildfire reached the outskirts of Stourbridge, UK, causing significant damage to at least six residential properties. Emergency responders worked to control the fire and thick smoke, which resulted in two people suffering from smoke inhalation and heat exposure. As a safety precaution, local train services were temporarily halted while crews managed the situation.
